label: exploratory
kind: sizing run at full population size
description: n = 20,000 per population, seeds 1000 to 1019 (disjoint from the confirmatory seeds 0 to 19). Cells d0.00-r1.00, d0.50-r1.00, d1.00-r2.00 with P0 to P3; EXP-003 cells B-sB2, C-student_t3, C-lognormal, D-k0.1-pB0.2 with P0 and P3. 400 runs. Purpose: runtime per run, projected full-matrix runtime, per-seed spread, degenerate cells, analytic cross-check of P0.
outputs: results/exploratory/sizing/ (results.json sha256 prefix 7df119da2c4e234b, run_manifest.json, tables/, figures/, report.md, report.pdf)

measurements.load_average_during_recorded_execution: about 81 (1 min), from other processes on the machine
measurements.p0_analytic_check: 28 of 28 metric-cell comparisons within 3 bootstrap SE (max |z| = 2.21)

determinism: the two executions produced identical results apart from runtime and memory fields (400 of 400 run records compared)
notes: Exploratory; not evidence for any hypothesis. Effect estimates in the report are not findings and must not be quoted as results. The run includes cells whose outcome bears on EXP-003 H2; disclosed in AP-006.

label: exploratory
description: n = 60, seeds 1500 to 1504; cells with a tiny Group B (p_B = 0.02), no qualified B (delta = 4), kappa = 0, kappa = 1, p_B = 0, and no measurement noise; P0 to P3. Checks that zero denominators and impossible fits are reported, not hidden.

measurements.failure_reasons: PolicyFitError: empty group B in the fitting population (P1, P2, P3 at p_B = 0, and at p_B = 0.02 for one seed); no qualified member of B (P3)
measurements.undefined_values: PPV null when nobody is selected (kappa = 0); TPR, FNR and EOG null when B has no qualified member; all with reasons

notes: No planned cell of EXP-001 to EXP-003 is degenerate: the SIZING run at n = 20,000 had zero failures and zero undefined values, including the smallest planned group (p_B = 0.2, kappa = 0.1).
